applyConstraints: Implement the normative bounded formatting surface without expanding to whole-repository Prettier.
Keep ESLint on the proven source/test surface; do not silently expand lint ownership to arbitrary repository JS/config files.
Remove only the six Explore-proven unused artifacts.
Keep src/**/*.ts max-lines=650 as the sole mechanical source-size failure threshold.
Keep exact control-regex and test overrides narrow.
Keep forbidden tracked-artifact matching exact and read-only.
Keep quality:gate mechanical-only; correctness checks remain Apply verification only.
Do not add dependency-cruiser, Knip, changed-file planning, baseline/waiver state, Registry, evidence platform, new lifecycle/authority surface, or internal version families.
